symptom: 504 Gateway Timeout detected on checkout endpoint under traffic surge
root_cause: HikariPool-1 connection pool exhaustion. Database connection pool max-lifetime was set to 30s while queries stalled on unindexed lock contention in checkout_transactions table, starving pool threads after 30000ms timeout.
resolution_steps: Temporarily increase HikariCP maximumPoolSize from 10 to 35 via ConfigMap hot-reload
Terminate long-running unindexed idle-in-transaction queries on payment-db-primary using pg_terminate_backend()
Trigger rolling restart of payment-gateway-v2 pods to clear exhausted thread pools
Deploy index on checkout_transactions (customer_id, status, created_at) to restore p99 query latency under 15ms
effective_runbook: RB-PAY-042: HikariCP Connection Pool Exhaustion & Idle Connection Purge

symptom: OOMKilled pods crashing repeatedly under elevated login requests
root_cause: Container memory limit 512Mi breached. Redis session tokens were written without TTL expiration following auth-v2.4 deploy, creating unbounded in-memory session hash growth until cgroup memory limit killed the pod.
resolution_steps: Scale auth-service Kubernetes deployment memory limit from 512Mi to 2Gi to stabilize running pods
Execute Redis scan and set default 86400s TTL on all orphaned session:* keys
Configure redis.conf maxmemory-policy to volatile-lru to evict expired tokens automatically under memory pressure
Roll back auth-service deployment to image v2.3.9 until session TTL patch is merged
effective_runbook: RB-AUTH-019: Session Cache OOM & Redis Memory Eviction Stabilization

symptom: Stale DNS resolution causing connection refusal to AWS SES SMTP endpoints
root_cause: CoreDNS upstream forwarder timeout in k8s cluster. CoreDNS pods cached negative NXDOMAIN response after AWS SES regional DNS rotation, causing outbound SMTP connection timeouts to email.us-east-1.amazonaws.com.
resolution_steps: Flush CoreDNS cache across kube-system namespace by performing rollout restart of coredns deployment
Verify outbound reachability to email.us-east-1.amazonaws.com port 587 from dispatcher pods using nc -zv
Update CoreDNS ConfigMap to reduce cache negative TTL from 300s to 10s for external AWS domains
Re-queue failed transaction notification events in dead-letter-queue DLQ-NOTIF-HIGH
effective_runbook: RB-NET-077: CoreDNS Resolver Stale Cache Flush & External Egress Recovery

symptom: Consumer lag spiking past 250,000 messages on topic orders.created.v1
root_cause: Kafka consumer group rebalance deadlock caused by slow synchronous RPC calls in message processing loop exceeding max.poll.interval.ms (300000ms), triggering continuous partitions revocation.
resolution_steps: Increase consumer group partitions from 12 to 24 on topic orders.created.v1 to allow horizontal worker scaling
Scale order-fulfillment-engine deployment replicas from 4 to 12 in kubernetes
Update consumer config max.poll.interval.ms from 300s to 900s and decouple slow inventory RPC into async worker thread pool
Monitor lag reduction using kafka-consumer-groups.sh until consumer lag drops below 1,000 messages
effective_runbook: RB-KAFKA-012: Consumer Lag Recovery & Rebalance Storm Resolution

symptom: Database CPU at 100% and connection saturation with query lock wait spikes
root_cause: Deadlock cycle on inventory_sku_levels table due to non-deterministic ordering of multi-item lock acquisition during batch checkout transactions.
resolution_steps: Identify blocking queries using pg_stat_activity with wait_event_type = 'Lock'
Kill root blocking PID using SELECT pg_cancel_backend(pid)
Hot-patch inventory service to enforce ascending SKU ID sorting prior to executing SELECT FOR UPDATE
Enable lock_timeout = '5s' in database connection parameters to prevent permanent pool starvation
effective_runbook: RB-DB-005: PostgreSQL Lock Contention & Transaction Deadlock Resolution

symptom: NGINX Ingress returning 502 Bad Gateway with worker_connections are not enough in error logs
root_cause: Default worker_connections limit (1024) exceeded during flash sale traffic burst, causing NGINX worker processes to drop incoming TCP handshakes.
resolution_steps: Update ingress-nginx-controller ConfigMap: set max-worker-connections to 16384 and worker-processes to 'auto'
Increase Linux kernel somaxconn and net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog to 65535 on cluster nodes
Perform rolling restart of ingress-nginx pods with zero downtime
Verify edge error rate drops to 0.00% on Grafana ingress dashboard
effective_runbook: RB-EDGE-033: NGINX Ingress Worker Saturation & Edge Backlog Tuning
